lede: The meeting to watch this week is the Ouray County Planning Commission on August 19, where three public hearings include a proposed repeal of an entire section of the county's land use regulations — the kind of code change that reshapes how future development gets reviewed. Also on Tuesday, the San Miguel County BOCC holds a public hearing on housing authority compliance procedures, Telluride's HARC takes up the unpermitted Elks Lodge pergola and the large-scale Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road, and the Town's P&Z gets its first formal look at the school district's employee housing proposal at the middle-high school site.

notable.stake: HARC votes on after-the-fact approval of unpermitted Elks Lodge pergola.
